title: Learnings and Pitfalls from AI-Assisted A/B Experimentation at Scale
title_zh: 大规模AI辅助A/B实验的经验与陷阱

paragraphs.en: 报告大规模AI辅助A/B实验经验：由LLM选择编排流程但由确定性代码计算数值，以兼顾可信性与效率。 A/B testing underpins product decisions by providing trustworthy, reproducible quantification of proposed changes' effects. Growing large language model (LLM) capabilities have motivated efforts to automate experimentation workflows. Yet LLMs are nondeterministic and prone to hallucination, properties that conflict with the trust experimentation systems must provide. Experiments are also operationally messy: diagnosing anomalies, debugging configurations, and conducting bespoke follow-up analyses require flexible reasoning and manual effort. These tasks let agents accelerate experimentation without replacing its deterministic statistical foundations. We report lessons from building and operating such an agent. Our central finding is that this tension is resolved not by making the model deterministic, but by bounding where its nondeterminism can reach; the model selects and sequences procedures, while deterministic code computes every quantity it reports. Three consequences surprised us: withholding information from the model improved its answers, demand concentrated on mundane retrieval rather than the autonomous decisions we anticipated, and the agent's eagerness to help threatened statistical validity.
paragraphs.zh: 报告大规模AI辅助A/B实验的经验：由LLM选择编排流程，但由确定性代码计算数值，以兼顾可信性与效率。A/B测试通过为拟议变更的效果提供可信、可复现的量化，为产品决策提供支撑。 大语言模型（LLM）能力的不断增强，推动了将实验工作流程自动化的各种努力。 然而LLM是非确定性的，且容易产生幻觉，这些特性与实验系统必须提供的可信度相冲突。 实验在运维层面也很繁杂：诊断异常、调试配置以及进行定制的后续分析都需要灵活的推理和人工投入。 这些任务让智能体能够加速实验，同时又不会取代实验的确定性统计基础。 我们报告构建和运营这样一个智能体所获得的经验教训。 我们的核心发现是，这一矛盾并非通过使模型变得确定性来解决，而是通过限定其非确定性所能触及的范围来解决；模型负责选择和排列流程，而它报告的每一个数值都由确定性代码计算得出。 有三个后果令我们意外：对模型隐瞒信息反而改善了它的回答，需求集中在平凡的数据检索而非我们所预期的自主决策上，而且智能体急于帮忙的倾向威胁到了统计有效性。
